_about: API list prices in US dollars per million tokens, used to show what subscription usage would cost on a pay-per-token API key. Edit freely; the server reloads this file on change. Models match by longest id prefix, so 'claude-opus-5-5' covers 'claude-opus-5-5[1m]'. cache_write_1h defaults to 2x input and cache_write to 1.25x input when omitted.
